description:
Internal alterations: Move the existing kitchen from the lower ground floor to the upper ground floor rear room. Reinstate the original, preserved timber double doors in the opening between the front and rear lower ground floor rooms, to create a separate bedroom and living room. Reconstruct the non-original lower ground floor stair.  Replace a non-original rear extension. Create a new lower ground floor bathroom. Remove the existing sanitaryware and the modern enclosure in front of the chimney breast in the first-floor rear room to create a bedroom. Convert the second-floor rear room to become a bathroom. 
 
External alterations: Replace the existing non-original lower ground floor rear garden door with new glazed French doors. Renovate the existing basement front lightwell glazed door and window under the entrance steps - replace the existing modern single glazing with slimline double glazing.  Replacement of second floor windows. Reinstatement of roller awnings to first floor front windows. Dress the front entrance steps asphalt with square edged Yorks stone steps and associated rear garden works.  Replacement of rear roof light. 
P2026/1588/FUL also submitted
decision_conditions:
3 YEAR CONSENT PERIOD:  The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
